# JunkValue

![JunkValue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thmastin/JunkValue/main/media/logo.png)

JunkValue is a standalone LibDataBroker source that displays the vendor value of sellable gray items in bags 0-4. It shows a compact money total, and its tooltip shows the total and number of stacks. It never sells, picks up, or deletes items.

## Install

Copy the `JunkValue` folder into your Forever client's `Interface\AddOns` directory, so `JunkValue.toc` is at `Interface\AddOns\JunkValue\JunkValue.toc`. Restart or reload the client and enable JunkValue in the AddOns list.

## EllesmereUI DataBars

Open EllesmereUI's DataBars settings, choose the bar you want to configure, and set its block type to **Broker Plugin**. Select **Junk** (the source is named `JunkValue`) from the broker plugin list.

## Options

Open the native JunkValue settings panel with `/junkvalue`, right-click the broker bar, or find **JunkValue** under Game Menu > Options > AddOns. In Display, choose the white glyph, pouch, or coin icon and turn **Show icon** on or off. The panel also groups behavior settings, shows both custom item lists, and lets you add an item ID or shift-click an item link to **Add to Always** or **Add to Never**. Each list row has a Remove button. **Clear Lists** requires a second click within five seconds.

Slash commands remain available: `/junkvalue add <itemlink or id>` counts an item as junk, including non-gray items; `/junkvalue never <itemlink or id>` keeps an item out, even if gray; `/junkvalue remove <itemlink or id>` removes it from both lists; `/junkvalue list` prints both lists; `/junkvalue clear` prompts you to type `/junkvalue clear confirm` within 10 seconds. Alt+right-click bag items in Blizzard or EllesmereUI bags to toggle gray items on the Never list and non-gray items on the Always list. The lists are account-wide SavedVariables. Custom items without a vendor price are skipped. JunkValue never sells, picks up, or deletes items.

## Tests

Run `luajit tests/run.lua` from this folder.

## Versioning

JunkValue uses Semantic Versioning (`MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`):

- **PATCH (1.1.x):** bug fixes and polish, with no new behavior. Small fixes are grouped into one patch release.
- **MINOR (1.x.0):** new features that don't break existing setups.
- **MAJOR (x.0.0):** breaking changes, such as renaming the data broker, resetting saved settings, or dropping a supported client.

A release is tagged only after an in-game check. GitHub Actions builds and uploads releases to CurseForge on `v*` tags.

# Changelog

All notable changes to JunkValue are documented here.

## [1.2.0] - 2026-11-10

### Added
- Add user-defined Always/Never junk lists, slash commands, and Alt+right-click toggling in Blizzard and EllesmereUI bags.
- Add the native options panel, available by right-clicking the bar or using `/junkvalue`.
- Add an icon picker with the white glyph, pouch, and coin, plus the Show icon toggle.

### Fixed
- Migrate existing users' settings and parse item links without changing their case.
- Remove the StaticPopup clear confirmation to prevent popup system taint.

## [1.1.1] - 2026-11-10

### Changed
- Display top junk stacks in two columns, remove the equals separator, and hide `x1` for single items.
- Add the README versioning policy and this changelog.

## [1.1.0] - 2026-11-10

### Added
- Show the top five junk stacks, session vendor earnings, and configurable options.

### Fixed
- Fix the tooltip showing `0c` by reading the same scan snapshot as the bar.

## [1.0.0] - 2026-11-10

### Added
- Initial release: a LibDataBroker data source showing total gray vendor value for the WoW Forever client.
